text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, it's cute. It feels so nice,
it must
be made
of pretty good fabric.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The clothes are well-sewn—it shows their
respect
for the original model.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So true. Getting to actually hold it in my
hands, I get a sense of, like, what the
makers were feeling,
or... what they
wanted to show.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That makes me want to work
harder.
